[SWS_DM_02060] Reaction on ApplicationError
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04277
⌈
If the return value of an ara::diag interface has an error of
ara::diag::DiagUdsNrcErrorDomain, the
Diagnostic Server instance
shall
return a negative response with the value of that error code.
⌋
7.3.2.7 Keep track of active non-default sessions
